description:
Orders Pagination Regression

Ticket ID: API-233

Service: Orders API

Priority: Medium

Reported By: Frontend Team

Context: After a recent backend change to introduce pagination on the /orders endpoint, multiple consumers reported missing, duplicated, or inconsistent results when navigating between pages.

Issue

The pagination logic was implemented quickly and contains off-by-one errors and missing validation. Invalid query parameters can also cause unpredictable responses.

Your Task

  • Fix the pagination calculation
  • Ensure page numbering starts at 1
  • Handle invalid or missing page and limit query parameters safely
  • Return deterministic, correct slices of data

Expected Behavior (Tests)

  • GET /orders?page=1&limit=10 should return orders starting from id 1
  • GET /orders?page=2&limit=10 should return orders starting from id 11
  • GET /orders with invalid query parameters should still return a valid, non-empty result set
